decisive_items: a dense inflammatory neutrophilic infiltrate within the dermis
an abrupt onset of an asymptomatic cutaneous eruption
response.rationale: Sweet syndrome is more likely due to the combination of a dense neutrophilic infiltrate, dermal edema, and abrupt onset of cutaneous eruption, despite some overlap with pyoderma gangrenosum

rejected.why: lack of epidermal changes on biopsy
